section: State legislature - Assembly and Legislative Council; creation and abolition of the Council (Article 169)

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the functioning of State Legislative Assemblies:
1. Odisha recorded 43 sitting days.
2. Nagaland recorded 7 sitting days.
3. The average sitting of Assemblies was 24 days.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: Odisha recorded 43 sitting days, Nagaland recorded 7, and the average for Assemblies was 24 days.
accepted.tq: Verify each numerical statement independently before selecting the coded combination.

accepted.s: With reference to the legislative activity of State Assemblies in 2025, which one of the following statements is correct?
o: More than half of the Bills were passed after consideration by a select committee.
All Bills passed by the Assemblies were passed in more than one sitting.
About one-third of more than 600 Bills were passed in a single sitting.
Exactly 50 per cent of the Bills were passed in a single sitting.
accepted.x: About 33 per cent, or nearly one-third, of the more than 600 Bills were passed in a single sitting.
accepted.tq: Distinguish an approximate proportion from absolute or exaggerated alternatives.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the office of Deputy Speaker in State Legislative Assemblies:
1. The office was vacant in eight States.
2. Jharkhand had no Deputy Speaker for 21 years.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
accepted.x: Both statements are correct. The Deputy Speaker’s post was vacant in eight States, and Jharkhand had no Deputy Speaker for 21 years.
accepted.tq: Check whether each statement supplies a distinct figure or duration before choosing the combination.

accepted.s: Who among the following was the first woman legislator in India?
accepted.x: Muthulakshmi Reddy was India’s first woman legislator and served in the Madras Legislative Council.
accepted.tq: Use the first-in-history clue and distinguish legislative office from executive office.

accepted.s: Muthulakshmi Reddy was associated with which one of the following legislative bodies?
accepted.x: Muthulakshmi Reddy became India’s first woman legislator in the Madras Legislative Council.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between the similarly named Assembly and Council institutions.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Telangana Legislative Council:
1. Two BRS Members of the Legislative Council were suspended for remarks against the Speaker.
2. Gaddam Prasad Kumar is the Chairman of the Telangana Legislative Council.
3. Gutha Sukender Reddy is the Chairman of the Telangana Legislative Council.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
accepted.x: Statement 1 is correct. Gaddam Prasad Kumar is the Speaker, whereas Gutha Sukender Reddy is the Chairman of the Telangana Legislative Council; therefore, statement 2 is false and statement 3 is correct.
accepted.tq: Apply the office-holder trap by separating the Speaker of the Assembly from the Chairman of the Council.

accepted.s: Which one of the following best describes the principal constitutional-democratic significance of a State Legislative Council?
o: It replaces the Legislative Assembly whenever the Council of Ministers resigns.
It exclusively controls the State’s financial legislation.
It directly appoints the Governor and the Chief Minister.
It checks hasty legislation and provides representation to experts who may not be able to face elections.
accepted.x: A Legislative Council acts as a revising chamber that can check hasty legislation and provide a place for experts who may not be able to secure election.
accepted.tq: Match the institutional function with the practical role of a revising chamber.

accepted.s: The criticism that a State Legislative Council is a costly ‘delaying chamber’ primarily relates to which of the following concerns?
o: It can permanently veto every Bill passed by the Legislative Assembly.
It alone possesses the power to introduce Money Bills in the State Legislature.
Its members are appointed entirely by the Union Government.
Its existence and effectiveness may depend heavily on the political strength of the ruling party in the Legislative Assembly.
accepted.x: Critics describe the Council as a costly delaying chamber because its political significance and continued existence may fluctuate with the ruling party’s position in the Assembly. It does not possess an absolute veto over Assembly legislation.
accepted.tq: Identify the institutional criticism without confusing delay with an absolute veto.

accepted.s: In which of the following years or periods did Andhra Pradesh illustrate the politically fluctuating status of the Legislative Council?
accepted.x: The Andhra Pradesh Legislative Council’s changing status was illustrated by developments in 1985, 2007 and 2020–21.
accepted.tq: Recall the distinctive three-point chronology rather than selecting a sequence of unrelated years.
